A '''Magnetic Projector''' was a component used in the construction of [[timer mine]]s. [[Conner Ship Systems]]' [[3HX3 timer mine]] featured a Magnetic Projector located above the [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive]] launcher.<ref name="EGWT" />
